decision: Revision 2 privacy correction (human, 2026-10-28) after migration/reviews/NS07-r1.md CHANGES_REQUIRED (P1)
phase: B and G run 2 (correction applied before revision 2 freeze)
finding: Phase B and G run 2 stored each raw screencap receipt as *-screencap.stdout.log / *-screenshot.stdout.log containing the PNG bytes. The phase B and G2 redactions covered only the PNGs, and the coordinator's F4 receipt fix searched only *.stdout.bin, so ten raw receipts kept the unredacted clipboard images. Their SHA-256 values equal the sha256Before values in redaction/record.json and redaction-g2/record.json. The statements in those two records that the clipboard content is absent from all receipts were wrong for these ten files; the records themselves are kept unchanged as history and are corrected by this record.
detection: Independent reviewer (migration/reviews/NS07-r1.md), then a coordinator scan of every file under migration/evidence/NS07/ by file signature (first bytes), not extension: 2,400 PNG payloads (1,200 .png, 766 .stdout.bin, 434 .stdout.log); exactly these ten held a recorded sha256Before digest.
correction: Each of the ten files was replaced by the bytes of its already-redacted paired PNG; each original was first copied to the git-ignored /_backup_ns07_redaction/<run>/receipts-r2/<name>.unredacted.bin and its SHA-256 verified there. Originals are never committed.
verificationAfter: Signature scan after the correction: 2,400 PNG payloads; 0 files hold any of the 30 distinct sha256Before digests recorded in redaction, redaction-g2, redaction-f2, redaction-f4, redaction-f6 and redaction-f9; 0 non-.png PNG payloads differ from a committed PNG; no JPEG/GIF/WebP/ZIP/GZIP/PDF/ELF/DEX signatures; no base64 image data in text files.
